hooks.command: bash -c 'COMMAND="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_command"; if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q "gh pr create"; then ls notes/story-*/review.md >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "WARNING: No code review artifact found. Run /finish-story to ensure code review before PR creation." >&2; fi'

bash -c 'COMMAND="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_command"; if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -q "git push"; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [[ "$BRANCH" == story-* ]]; then STORY_NUM=$(echo "$BRANCH" | sed "s/story-\([0-9]*\).*/\1/"); echo "Reminder: update notes/flight-board.md for story #$STORY_NUM" >&2; fi; fi'

bash -c 'WORKTREES=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep "^worktree" | grep -v "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)$" || true); if [ -n "$WORKTREES" ]; then DIRTY=""; for wt in $(echo "$WORKTREES" | sed "s/worktree //"); do if [ -n "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then DIRTY="$DIRTY  $wt\n"; fi; done; if [ -n "$DIRTY" ]; then printf "WARNING: Worktrees with uncommitted changes:\n%b" "$DIRTY" >&2; fi; fi'
